title: Aussalzeffekt und Ionenhydratation
experimental_method: Gas burette connected by a 2 m coiled glass capillary to a shaken absorption vessel; gas volume taken up by thoroughly degassed water or salt solution after equilibration (Ostwald-Luther method); measured mostly at 0 and 20 C.
quality_remarks: Directly reported quantity is the Ostwald coefficient alpha' = c_fl/c_gas = v_gas/v_fl (eq 1). Pressure not stated. Salt concentration c' in mol per 1000 g water. Table 1 a LiCl 20 C row c' 0.88 prints alpha' 0,251, inconsistent with its own log column (implies 0.0251); kept as printed. Tabelle 1 a LiCl 0 C c' 1,64 is inconsistent with its own log and k' columns (imply c' about 1.04); kept as printed. Text says the agreement with older data is generally satisfactory except Akerloef's argon salting out (smaller); a discrepancy with v. Antropoff's xenon water value. LiCl is outside the six-ion set; Ar and Xe outside the seven gases. Text layer misread the NaCl/O2 15 C block as 35 C. Stoessell and Byrne (1982, Clays Clay Miner.) cite this paper as 'Eucker and Hertzberg (1950)'.
